panels.description:
DataSource: Thanos

Query: thread_pool_queue_size

Description: A connection is active when it is used by a thread of the application, which means, the connection is outside the pool and cannot be used by any other thread. If Active count == Thread pool then all the resources are being used, which may lead to exhaustiveness.
panels.title: Active Count

panels.description:
DataSource: Thanos

Query: thread_pool_queue_size

Description: A pending thread is a thread that requires a connection but couldn’t find any inside the pool, more pending request implies the system is exhausted with threads.
panels.title: Pending Requests

Description: Increase in Memory will show direct impact on application availability. Check if the app is allocated with enough resources. If there is no HPA setup, make sure if the deployment is properly scaled.
